title: Order Security Group
content:
Note creating security groups used for access to GitHub and Azure DevOps is currently done by someone in DevOps Team.

The teams in GitHub is managed via Azure AD security groups. The standard setup is one security group that represents members in the team. To create a security group create a ticket in Inter IKEA service desk. The ticket should contain text below where {team} is replaced with current team name e.g. WALLDECO-TEAM_IPEX-IIG-CBF-SG:

What is the purpose of this security group? Will it be used for any application? Please elaborate.: Grant access to DevOps tooling and resources for an IPEX product team.

Additional comments Please Create the Azure AD security group {team}-TEAM_IPEX-IIG-SG in Inter Ikea Group (one IIG) tenant. Make me owner of the group and add the to GitHub Enterprise application.

Figure: Request in Inter IKEA service desk

When security group has been created add Product Owner and Architecture Manager as owner to group as owners.
